synopsis: CarSim and TruckSim are commercial, road-heritage dynamics tools owned by Applied Intuition through its March 2022 acquisition of Mechanical Simulation [f9128, f15971, f8402]. Chapter 11 includes them among vehicle and machine dynamics, terrain and soil offerings, and reports Simulink and other unspecified interfaces; sensor capabilities are listed as not applicable [f8356, f9131, f9130]. A 2022 press release claimed expansion into off-road, agricultural, construction and mining applications, with the Chapter 11 account also mentioning military applications [f15972, f8585, f9129]. However, their current off-road depth was not verified, so the expansion claim does not establish present suitability for heavy off-road validation [f8586, f15972]. No public price or latest release was found, leaving procurement and version information unresolved [f9132, f9133].
